issue.title: Keep the Plugins Updates list width stable when its banner toggles
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-100.4 note #3 during Refresh-panel visual verification. The Plugins Updates list sits at a one-row overflow boundary when the not-uv-tool banner appears; CLI availability changes can make the 120x40 frame flap. Add a stable scrollbar gutter to the pane list and a regression that exercises the banner boundary.

task_type_fields.impact: The Plugins layout and its visual snapshot flap even though the list content is unchanged; users see a horizontal reflow when the banner appears or disappears.
task_type_fields.repro: Open Config Center > Plugins at 120x40 with a one-row Updates list, then toggle the not-uv-tool banner by changing agent CLI availability. The OptionList crosses its scrollbar threshold and changes width because its rule has no stable scrollbar gutter.

payload.close_reason: Stale task bead swept from triage.
